1. **F1 — blocking, issue-impact, medium:** Repeated `--profile` selectors produce a second rehearsal entry marked `unchanged` but retain the first occurrence’s `create`/`update` targets. `selection_observations` clones the entry and the planner changes only its status, so human output can state “unchanged” then print updates the second occurrence will not publish. This violates the requirement that rehearsal reports the decisions it would publish. [crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:1449](@/issue/7156f64b/requirement/REQ-04)
